title: AshenMC
description: AshenMC is a new and exciting Cobblemon server experience that offers an improved playing experience with loads of custom content!
body:
🔥 **Welcome to AshenMC!** 🔥

Are you ready to embark on your next Cobblemon adventure? Our Cobblemon SMP server takes your Cobblemon gameplay to the next level with enhanced gameplay and loads of custom features for you to enjoy!

🌍 **Explore, Battle & Conquer!**\
Step into a vast Cobblemon world spanning Generations 1-9, where you can battle trainers from around the globe, explore endless biomes, and take on challenging gyms to prove yourself as the ultimate Pokémon Master! Will you rise to the top, or will you be lost in the thrill of adventure?

🔗 **Join the Adventure!**\
🌀 **Discord**: [discord.gg/ashenmc](https://discord.gg/ashenmc)\
🌐 **Server Website**: ashenmc.net\
⚡ **Cobblemon's Official Sites**: https://cobblemon.com/en
